description: This file contains PHP classes related to testing the connection functionality of the YouTrack client, including a helper class for connection testing and a unit test class for the connection class.

classes.name: TestConnection
classes.description: A helper class for connection testing that extends the main Connection class and overrides the _login method to do nothing.

classes.name: ConnectionTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the Connection class, using PHPUnit framework.

methods.name: _login
methods.description: A protected method overridden in TestConnection to bypass actual login logic.

methods.name: test_get_issue
methods.description: A test method that instantiates the TestConnection to verify connection setup.
